summary:
Comprehensive Client-Side Security Audit Report for Athar (com.athar.islamic) across all 10 MASVS areas:
1. Executive Risk Summary & Assessment Scorecard.
2. Area-by-Area Technical Findings (Severity, Evidence, File Path, Exploit Scenario, Recommended Fix, and Regression Test):
   - Finding 1 (Critical/High): Keystore binary & historical credentials in repository.
   - Finding 2 (Medium): Incomplete backup exclusion rules for internal SQLite/IndexedDB in data_extraction_rules.xml.
   - Finding 3 (Low): Raw e.printStackTrace() calls logging to System.err/Logcat in production.
   - Areas 4–10 (Pass/Hardened): Safe JS bridging, zero cleartext HTTP, strict Firebase rules, strict APK updater whitelisting, and no hardcoded private tokens.
3. Remediation Roadmap & Safe History Cleanup Protocol (git-filter-repo / BFG guidance without modifying files).
4. Automated & Manual Regression Test Suite.
